calls.prompt: Full-body orthographic front view of a Roman auxiliary slinger, a lean young man with a plain clean-shaven face: a close-fitting cap helmet with short cheek flaps; a short-sleeved tunic ending above the knee with a studded leather jerkin over the chest; a leather sling coiled and tucked into the wide belt at his right hip; a large leather shoulder bag of stones on a strap across the chest, hanging at his left hip, with a small net pouch of stones at his right hip; laced leather wraps from the ankles to below the knees and simple leather sandals. He stands in a neutral A-pose: arms straight, held out and angled about 35 degrees down away from the torso so they do not touch the body or the bags, open empty hands with fingers together, legs slightly apart, feet flat. The sling stays coiled at the belt. No fire, no effects. He faces the camera directly, symmetrical, the whole figure from head to sandals visible with empty margin around it, centred on a plain flat light grey background, no scenery, no ground, a single character. Game-ready 3D character model reference for a modeller: simple large readable shapes, chunky proportions, big hands, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no texture detail. Palette blocks: tunic undyed linen beige, jerkin dark brown leather, cap helmet iron grey, belt, sling, shin wraps and sandals mid brown leather, stone bags warm tan leather with muted red-brown straps, skin warm tan, hair mid brown. Soft even studio light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark.
